messages:
emma: Kicking off a small blue->green traffic shift on edge pool us-west-1. Plan: 5% steps every 3m, smoke probes between steps. Target p95 < 150ms and errors < 0.5%
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=web-router@2026.03.21-rc7 -> green pool (job 78234). Canaries enabled.
ops-bot: Note: maintenance window ends 2026-03-21T21:30Z. Quota checks passed.
sahil: copying the roll-forward checklist here: 1) small step 2) health probe 3) wait 3m 4) repeat. If error rate > 1% in any step -> immediate rollback.
jordan: acknowledging. I'm standing by to pin session affinity if we see stickiness regressions.
deploy-bot: traffic adjusted: green=5% blue=95% (t=+00:03) :white_check_mark:
emma: probe results after 1st step: p95=138ms, 0.12% 5xx. looks good. advancing in 3.
linda: FYI released release-notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/web-router/2026.03.21-rc7 (short list: kernel selection tweak, keepalive tweak, session cookie bugfix)
sahil: quick note — if you see session cookie mismatch for old clients, we should pin the cookie name to old value. Jordan can you be ready to execute `ops pin-cookie --name session`?
jordan: ready.
ops-bot: traffic adjusted: green=10% blue=90% (t=+00:06)
emma: after 10% probe: p95=145ms, errors 0.3%. continuing.
deploy-bot: traffic adjusted: green=20% blue=80% (t=+00:09)
emma: 20% probe shows an uptick to 0.9% errors (mostly 502 from upstream pool). investigating with infra.
sahil: if error distribution concentrated in a region / ASG, we can throttle to 10% and run a partial rollback. prefer to avoid full rollback if backend autoscaling will stabilize.
jordan: seeing logs: `upstream-connector` hitting connection resets from pool-a. tagging owners @infra-team.
linda: tagging support channel for customer-impact watch: #support (no alerts yet).
ops-bot: traffic adjusted: green=15% blue=85% (manual throttle by emma) :warning:
emma: throttled to 15% while infra investigates. decision threshold: if 5xx > 1% for 2 consecutive probes -> rollback to blue and mark channel for postmortem.
deploy-bot: rollforward paused.
infra-bot: backend pool-a nodes observed 3% CPU spike and brief SYN backlog. Auto-repair triggered one replacement.
sahil: given auto-repair, I'd hold at 15% for two cycles. if next probe p95 < 200ms and errors < 1% we can resume ramp.
jordan: agreed. if we need immediate rollback I will run: `deploy-bot rollback job=78234 target=blue`
emma: holding. thanks everyone. will update in ~6m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ops-bot: health-check probe @ t=+00:12: p95=152ms, errors=0.8%
emma: good. infra says replacements finished. I'll resume 5% increments after this next probe.
ops-bot: traffic adjusted: green=20% blue=80% (resume by emma)
emma: final note: pinning routing version for special-cases: `route-pin --path /v1/legacy --to blue --until 2026-03-22T03:00Z` to keep legacy sessions stable. jordan, can you file the short rollback rationale in the release thread if we end up rolling back?
jordan: yep will document.
sahil: nice coordination. if all stays green we'll close the change window and mark the release as staged. :tada:
emma: closing watch in 20m if stable. thanks team!
